manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the blue cup onto the small drink-protecting wooden coaster.

Task description: Move the blue cup on the right side of the table onto the small round wooden coaster in front and to its left, then release the cup.

Success criteria: The blue cup's bottom is nearly aligned horizontally with the wooden coaster's support surface and rests on it, supported rather than still suspended above it. Both grippers are open and have released the cup.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping an unobstructed cup-wall section near the front of the table, with one finger inside and one outside and pads contacting below the rim. Adjust the opening to wall thickness and entry clearance to reduce sweeping into neighboring objects.
- Before closing, use a side view to confirm that the fingers are on the inside and outside of the cup wall with adequate pad contact, avoiding slipping or pushing the cup over by pressing only the top rim.
- Keep the cup opening facing up during transport and lift the base clear of the table before moving laterally, avoiding dragging it or hitting the coaster edge.
- Judge coaster alignment using the cup-bottom outline rather than only its opening. Release once the bottom is supported, withdrawing the inner finger upward through the opening to avoid lifting or toppling the cup.
